pages.text: It's part of the $(l:building/containment_ring)containment ring$(): the outermost middle block of the $(thing)north-east$() beam port tunnel, $(num)12$() east and $(num)12$() north of the core at core height, in place of a Ring Beam Port. Feed it RF from outside the ring and use $(thing)Laser +$() to fire it.

The beam bends around the core and comes back stronger: $(num)1.15x$() at low power, up to $(num)1.30x$() at full power.$(br2)The profit comes out of your mass: $(num)1$() mass per $(num)400,000 RF$() fired (half a mass a tick at full power). Keep the stabilizers fed.
pages.title: Gain
